summary_1line: Lomasa shows sacred sites and begins the tale of Yavakri, whose harsh austerities force Indra to grant him Vedic knowledge despite warnings.

image_candidates.scene_text: An aged, frail ascetic—Indra in disguise—stoops on the bank of the roaring Ganga, throwing handfuls of sand to build an impossible dam.
Yavakri stands amid blazing ritual fires during severe penance, his body exposed to heat as he seeks instant mastery of the Vedas.
The sage Lomasa gestures across a landscape of rivers, mountains, and hermitages while guiding Yudhishthira and the Pandavas on pilgrimage.
